versions.changelog:
Initial release of feature-flag-cleanup skill.

- Audits feature flag debt across LaunchDarkly, Unleash, Flagsmith, GrowthBook, Split, and home-grown systems.
- Detects and classifies stale flags, tagging owners using git blame and CODEOWNERS.
- Generates a risk-ranked removal plan, including owner-tagged tickets and removal pull requests.
- Produces a four-week cleanup playbook with rollback strategies.
- Supports migrations, vendor decommissioning, and per-team audits.
